note: Per-tile ROC-AUC z curves for the paired PHerc0139 experiment. A = aligned representation, N = native9 representation. 'own' = scored on that family's own label rasterisation, 'res' = scored on the other family's rasterisation, resampled. Nine z offsets, common in-phase grid.

unlocked.description: no phase lock (artefact, not a result)

mod8_native.description: patch origin mod 8 = 0, tiles anchored on the native chunk grid

mod32_aligned.description: patch origin mod 32 = 0 (training grid), aligned anchor

mod32_native.description: patch origin mod 32 = 0 (training grid), native anchor
